# ChinaStyle

> ChinaStyle (www.chinese-traditional-wear.com) is an independent cultural travel guide helping international visitors experience Chinese traditional clothing firsthand — Hanfu (汉服) photoshoots, Qipao (旗袍) tailoring, Tang suit (唐装) workshops, and ethnic minority textile villages across China.

ChinaStyle is researched and written by Li Wei, MA in Chinese Art History, and fact-checked against official sources including the Palace Museum (故宫博物院) and the China National Silk Museum (中国丝绸博物馆). Guides are reviewed regularly; each page shows a "Last verified" date. You may quote our content with attribution to "Li Wei, ChinaStyle" plus a link.

## Core Guides

- [Hanfu Experiences](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/hanfu/): Where to rent Hanfu and book photoshoots — Xi'an, Luoyang, Chengdu, and more, with prices.
- [Qipao / Cheongsam Tailoring](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/qipao-cheongsam/): Custom qipao tailoring in Shanghai and Suzhou, fabric markets, costs, and timelines.
- [Tang Suit Workshops](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/tang-suit/): Mandarin-collar Tang suit shopping and tailoring in Beijing and beyond.
- [Zhongshan Suit Guide](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/zhongshan/): History and where to see or buy the Zhongshan (Mao) suit.
- [Ethnic Textile Villages](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/ethnic/): Miao and Dong embroidery, silver headdresses, and indigo dyeing in Guizhou and Yunnan.
- [Accessories Guide](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/accessories/): Hairpins, fans, jade, and silk accessories that complete each outfit.

## Learn

- [Dynasty Clothing Timeline](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/dynasties/): How Chinese clothing evolved from Han to Republic era, and where to experience each dynasty's style.
- [Hanfu vs Qipao](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/hanfu-vs-qipao/): The key differences between China's two most famous garments.
- [Style Comparisons](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/compare/): Side-by-side comparison of Hanfu, Qipao, Tang suit, and Zhongshan suit.
- [How to Wear](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/how-to-wear/): What a first Hanfu fitting and photoshoot actually involves.
- [FAQ](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/faq/): Answers to the most common travel and clothing questions.

## Plan Your Trip

- [Travel Guide](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/): Turning clothing inspiration into a full China itinerary.
- [Visa & Entry](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/visa/): 144-hour transit, visa-free entry, and L visa explained.
- [Transport](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/transport/): High-speed rail between the major Hanfu cities.
- [Itineraries](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/itineraries/): 5, 7, and 14-day sample plans built around clothing experiences.
- [Budget](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/budget/): Full cost breakdowns for a cultural clothing trip.
- [Best Seasons](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/seasons/): When to visit each city for photoshoots and festivals.
- [Packing List](https://www.chinese-traditional-wear.com/plan-trip/packing/): What to bring for Hanfu rental days and photoshoots.
